rationale: The stock gapped down ~27% at the open on extremely elevated relative volume (9.57x), indicating a significant fundamental catalyst driving aggressive selling. While price has bounced from the low ($10.33) to $11.21 and sits at 67% of today's range with momentum appearing to stall on the last candle (bearish close at $11.20 after reaching $11.31), the wide spread (44.6 bps), high ATR relative to price, and the broader risk-off environment (SPY -1.02%, VIXY +5.60%) create unfavorable risk/reward for either direction — a long risks resumption of the gap-down selling pressure, while a short at this level is chasing a move already well underway with unclear continuation.
